metadata.educational_topic: Camels: mamas and babies hum to each other, a baby walks soon after birth, tough skin on the knees
metadata.parent_summary: A 5-minute bedtime adventure with Milo the bluebird. Your child follows Sandy's first night away from home, learns three camel facts, and sees how a song from home and good friends help when you miss someone. Nobody is hurt, lost or scared.
